title: Microsoft 365 admin center: rules that automate agent lifecycle management
summary: Hold: Microsoft's current service description classifies conditions-based lifecycle rules as a premium Agent 365 capability, contrary to the briefing's promise of no additional licence and no cost for Copilot-licensed tenants. The documented paths and API operations are supported, but the licensing and cost statements need correction.
